input-field.name: maxQuantity
input-field.label: Maximum quantity
最大数量

input-field.name: showDeliveryTime
input-field.label: Show delivery time in cart
在购物车中显示配送时间

input-field.name: openOffcanvasAfterAddToCart
input-field.label: Open offcanvas cart after adding a product
加入商品后打开侧边购物车
input-field.helpText: When enabled, the offcanvas cart will automatically open after adding a product. When disabled, only a success message will be displayed. Disable this if customers tend to add many products to their shopping cart.
开启后，加入商品会自动打开侧边购物车；关闭后只显示成功提示。如果顾客习惯一次加入多件商品，建议关闭。

input-field.name: enableOrderRefunds
input-field.label: Allow customers to cancel orders
允许顾客取消订单
input-field.helpText: Allows customers to cancel their own orders in the account area, as long as the order status is still "Open". Cancelling sets the order status to "Cancelled"; the selected payment method and all applied promotions are lost.
允许顾客在账户中心自行取消订单，前提是订单状态仍为「未处理」。取消后订单状态变为「已取消」；所选支付方式与已应用的促销都会失效。

input-field.name: paymentFinalizeTransactionTime
input-field.label: Time in minutes for a customer to finalize a transaction
顾客完成支付交易的时限（分钟）

input-field.name: lineItemAddLimit
input-field.label: Maximum addable products to cart per minute through API
通过 API 每分钟最多可加入购物车的商品数

input-field.name: showSubtotal
input-field.label: Show subtotal column
显示小计列

input-field.name: columnTaxInsteadUnitPrice
input-field.label: Order confirm page: tax column instead of unit price
订单确认页：以税额列替代单价列

input-field.name: showTosCheckbox
input-field.label: Customers are required to agree to the terms and conditions
顾客必须同意服务条款

input-field.name: showCustomerComment
input-field.label: Show comment field on checkout confirm page
在结算确认页显示备注栏

input-field.name: logoutGuestAfterCheckout
input-field.label: Automatically log out guest customers after order completion
下单完成后自动退出游客账号

input-field.name: showLegalGuaranteeNotice
input-field.label: Show legal guarantee notice on checkout page
在结算页显示法定质保提示
input-field.helpText: Displays the EU-harmonised legal guarantee notice in the customer's storefront language.
以顾客的店铺前台语言显示欧盟统一口径的法定质保提示。

input-field.name: showLegalGuaranteeNoticeInline
input-field.label: Display legal guarantee notice directly on checkout
Gewährleistungshinweis direkt auf der Bestellabschlussseite anzeigen
input-field.helpText: Shows the complete legal guarantee notice below the terms and conditions on the checkout page, instead of displaying only a link. Requires the legal guarantee notice to be enabled.
Zeigt den vollständigen Gewährleistungshinweis auf der Bestellabschlussseite unter den AGB an, anstatt nur einen Link anzuzeigen. Der Gewährleistungshinweis muss dafür aktiviert sein.

input-field.name: wishlistEnabled
input-field.label: Activate wishlist
启用心愿单
